data.text: Chinese state media says DeepSeek and MiniMax have completed the registration required to release and license their AI models overseas. The companies have not confirmed it. The approvals come one week after Beijing proposed export controls covering 23 AI technologies, including

Days after China proposed export controls on 23 AI technologies, Beijing just approved DeepSeek and MiniMax for global use. Same week, opposite signals. The AI race is officially a two-front war, permission slips and all. Whose rules shape your stack?
